units.source_text: （二）此书作者为当时宫廷一女官紫式部。

en.t: (2) The author of this book was Murasaki Shikibu, a lady-in-waiting at the court of that time.

units.source_text: 此人生卒年月不确，一说生于圆融天皇天元元年，

en.t: The exact dates of her birth and death are uncertain; according to one account, she was born in the first year of the Tengen era under Emperor Enyu,

units.source_text: 即公历九七八年，殁于一○一五年。

en.t: that is, in 978 by the Western calendar, and died in 1015.

units.source_text: 享年三十八岁；或曰，享年三十九岁；或曰，享年五十七岁。

en.t: Some say she died at thirty-eight; others say thirty-nine; still others say fifty-seven.

units.source_text: 其人生而颖悟，幼时旁听父亲教长兄读《史记》，

en.t: She was naturally bright, and as a child she listened from the side while her father taught her elder brother to read the Records of the Grand Historian,
yet she proved better than her elder brother at remembering and reciting it.

units.source_text: 后曾入宫为皇后讲解白居易诗文。

en.t: Later she entered the palace and explained the poetry and prose of Bai Juyi for the empress.

units.source_text: 又擅长琴筝，并精通佛典。

en.t: She was also skilled at the qin and zheng, and was well versed in Buddhist scriptures.

units.source_text: 二十二岁嫁藤原宣孝，生女贤子，亦有文名。

en.t: At twenty-two she married Fujiwara no Nobutaka and gave birth to a daughter, Kenshi, who also became known for her writing.

units.source_text: 紫式部寡居时作《源氏物语》。

en.t: Murasaki Shikibu wrote The Tale of Genji while living as a widow.

units.source_text: 或曰，末尾“宇治十帖”是贤子所续成；

en.t: Some say that the final Uji chapters were continued and completed by Kenshi;

units.source_text: 或曰，其父藤原为时创作大纲，由紫式部补写细部；

en.t: others say that her father, Fujiwara no Tametoki, created the outline and Murasaki Shikibu filled in the details;

units.source_text: 或曰，《源氏物语》在紫式部之前早已有之，乃由紫式部修订而成者。

en.t: still others say that The Tale of Genji already existed before Murasaki Shikibu and was revised into its present form by her.
Because so much time has passed, the facts can no longer be verified.
